北京太空算力创新中心揭牌: Beijing Space Computing Innovation Center Unveiled
本报北京电 （记者王昊男）6月29日，2026全球数字经济大会·太空算力论坛在: BEIJING — (Reporter Wang Haoman) On June 29, the 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference·Space Computing Forum was held at the Zhongguancun Exhibition Center in Haidian District, Beijing
活动现场，北京太空算力创新中心正式揭牌: At the event, the Beijing Space Computing Innovation Center was officially unveiled
该中心位于海淀区北京卫星小镇，定位为以畅通产业链、协同上下游为重要内容的太空算力: The center is located in Beijing Satellite Town in Haidian District and is positioned as a space computing innovation center with focus on unblocking the industry chain and coordinating upstream and downstream players, operating in a "company plus alliance" dual-drive mode
该中心围绕太空算力全产业链，系统布局太空原生算力芯片设计与研制、高性能超带宽的太: The center systematically deploys six research directions around the entire space computing industry chain: design and development of space-native computing chips, high-performance ultra-broadband space computing payloads, satellite platforms and ground verification infrastructure, large model deployment and software-hardware collaborative optimization, sky-ground integrated cloud platform key technology research and development, and satellite application technology innovation and scenario verification, establishing full-stack coordination of "chips—hardware—platforms—intelligence—networks—applications," and systematically creating a space computing native industry ecosystem
中心揭牌的同时，北京太空算力创新中心专家委员会和北京太空算力创新联盟同步成立: As the center was unveiled, the Beijing Space Computing Innovation Center Expert Committee and Beijing Space Computing Innovation Alliance were simultaneously established
北京太空算力创新中心专家委员会汇聚包括12名院士在内的30名专家，覆盖6G空天地: The Beijing Space Computing Innovation Center Expert Committee brings together 30 experts, including 12 academicians, covering technology fields such as 6G space-ground-integrated communication and microprocessors and integrated circuits
北京太空算力创新联盟首批意向成员单位108家，涵盖高校、科研院所、央国企及民营企: The Beijing Space Computing Innovation Alliance's First Batch of Prospective Member Organizations Numbers 108, Encompassing Universities, Research Institutions, Central and State-Owned Enterprises, and Private Enterprises, and Will Focus on the Needs of Aerospace Power Development and Artificial Intelligence Computing Power System Construction, Gather Resources from Academia, Industry, Research, and Finance, Deepen Collaborative Innovation, Jointly Build a Space Computing Industry Innovation Ecosystem Featuring Resource Sharing, Complementary Advantages, and Win-Win Cooperation, and Promote Breakthroughs in Key Space Computing Technologies, Industry Chain Collaborative Innovation and Standard-Setting, Public Service Capability Development, and Scenario Application Implementation
